errors.text_span: 按顺时针方向依次为：生活工作（浅蓝色，23.3%）、生产（青绿色，16.91%）、身体动作（浅灰蓝色，9.9%）、社交（浅蓝色，6.6%）、其他（深蓝色，19.38%）、战争（深红色，8.87%）、文教（深蓝灰色，5.57%）和生理活动（深蓝色，9.48%）
errors.evidence: The clockwise order of slices in the left pie chart is described incorrectly. For example, starting from '生活工作', the next slice is '生理活动' (9.48%), not '生产' (16.91%).

errors.text_span: 切片按比例大小大致呈递减顺序排列
errors.evidence: The slices of the left pie chart are not arranged in descending order of size. For example, the slice '社交' (6.6%) is followed by '其他' (19.38%), which is an increase, not a decrease.

errors.text_span: 文教（深灰色，未标注百分比但可估算约4.26%）
errors.evidence: The category '文教' (Culture/Education) is not present in the right-side pie chart; it is in the left one. Additionally, the description falsely claims its percentage is unstated and estimates it, when in fact all slices on the right chart have labeled percentages.
The category '战争' (War) with a value of 8.87% is in the left pie chart, not the right one. The right pie chart contains '争斗' (Struggle) with the value 9.57%.

errors.text_span: 从视觉上按顺时针方向依次为：方位改变（橙色，18.09%）、交通（深棕色，5.32%）、判断（深灰蓝色，8.51%）、司法（深灰色，10.64%）、文教（深灰色，未标注百分比但可估算约4.26%）、心理活动（紫红色，10.64%）、战争（深红色，9.57%）、争斗（深紫色，9.57%）、帮助（橙色，4.26%）和表情（浅橙色，5.32%）
errors.evidence: The description of the slices in the right pie chart is almost entirely incorrect. The clockwise order is wrong, several categories are misidentified (e.g., '交通' instead of '际遇'), colors are wrong (e.g., '交通' is light teal, not brown), and categories are hallucinated ('文教', '战争') while others are completely missed ('物态事态', '际遇').
The description of the right pie chart completely omits the largest slice, '物态事态', which accounts for 23.4%.
The description of the right pie chart omits the slice for '际遇' (5.32%).

errors.text_span: 部分切片（如“方位改变”和“心理活动”）比例相近
errors.evidence: The example given for slices with similar proportions is poor. '方位改变' (18.09%) and '心理活动' (10.64%) are not particularly close. Better examples from the chart would be '心理活动' (10.64%) and '司法' (10.64%), which are identical, or '心理活动' (10.64%) and '争斗' (9.57%).
